planner.description: This agent proactively identifies Renewal Opportunities that require attention and prioritization. It analyzes open Renewal Opportunities using factors such as contract expiration dates, customer engagement history, CSAT scores, support case activity, and overall account health signals to assess renewal risk. Based on this analysis, the agent determines the likelihood of churn or delayed renewal and recommends appropriate next actions. It generates personalized renewal outreach email drafts tailored to the customer's situation, suggests engagement strategies, and automatically creates follow-up tasks for Opportunity owners to ensure timely action. The objective of the agent is to improve renewal outcomes, increase customer retention, and reduce churn risk through proactive and intelligent intervention.

localTopics.description: Provides answers to contract renewal and customer retention related business questions by retrieving, aggregating, and analyzing Salesforce data related to Renewal Opportunities, Contracts, Accounts, Cases, Activities, and customer engagement metrics. The agent treats Renewal Opportunities as opportunities associated with the renewal of existing customer contracts or subscriptions. It identifies contract renewals that require attention by evaluating contract expiration dates, renewal opportunity status, customer activity, support case history, CSAT scores, and other available account health indicators. The agent can retrieve and summarise renewal information, identify contracts approaching expiration, prioritise renewal opportunities based on churn risk, recommend next actions, and coordinate with specialized agents responsible for generating renewal outreach email drafts, creating follow-up tasks, and posting Chatter notifications. Also the privileged user can approve the Approval request. for such case traverse to the subagent Agentforce slack integration action ApprovalRequest action. The agent acts as the primary entry point for contract renewal management requests and routes actions to the appropriate specialized agents when required.
